“ ‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.
translations.bsb: The city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat within it. I will judge you even to the borders of Israel.
translations.kjv: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:
translations.asv: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; I will judge you in the border of Israel;
